The [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] '''Wraith Three''' referred to the third member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] [[Wraith Squadron]]. The call sign was first held by [[Falynn Sandskimmer]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and vehicle expert.<ref name="X-Wing" />

After Sandskimmer's death, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] veteran [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] took over the call sign until after the [[Battle for the Razor's Kiss|battle]] for the ''[[Razor's Kiss]]'' concluded.<ref name="IF">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> 

It was then assigned to [[Myn Donos]], a survivor of [[Talon Squadron (New Republic)|Talon Squadron]] and a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]]. After the conclusion of the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], Donos transferred to Rogue Squadron.<ref name="SC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>

By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the Wraiths were reformed by [[Wraith Leader (callsign)|Wraith Leader]] [[Garik Loran]] to prove the corrupt activities of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]. [[Wraith One]] [[Bhindi Drayson]] was assigned to lead the team, while the Wraith Three call sign was assigned to [[Myri Antilles]], a [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] and the daughter of Wraith Squadron founder [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

Unbeknownst to Myri's team, Loran also secretly formed a second unit of Wraiths under Wraith veteran [[Sharr Latt]]. The second team's Wraith Three call sign was assigned to [[Thaymes Fodrick]], a computer [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
